eventOverviewSubtitle1: A 10-week celebration of quantum science across LA, part of the
series_desc: A 10-week summer event series to make quantum science engaging, accessible, and impactful for a diverse audience across LA, in collaboration with USC, Caltech, UCLA, Chapman and industry partners.

eventOverviewDesc.title: Increase awareness of quantum science
eventOverviewDesc.description: Bringing quantum concepts to the public through engaging events and accessible explanations.

eventOverviewDesc.title: Engage families, students, and professionals
eventOverviewDesc.description: Creating inclusive events for all ages and expertise levels throughout Los Angeles.

eventOverviewDesc.title: Collaborate with academia and industry
eventOverviewDesc.description: Partnering with USC, Caltech, UCLA, Chapman, industry leaders to bring expert knowledge to the public.

eventOverviewDesc.title: Make quantum science fun and accessible
eventOverviewDesc.description: Transforming complex concepts into enjoyable, interactive experiences for everyone.

joinSummerTitle: Join us for a summer of quantum discovery!
joinSummerDesc: From public lectures and quantum lab tours to quantum games and "Quantum at the Bar" events, our free 10-week program offers something for everyone. Join our mailing list to stay updated on all the exciting quantum events happening across Los Angeles!
upcomingEventsSubtitle: Join us for a summer of quantum discovery! Our free 10-week program has something for everyone.

publicTalks.title: Public Talks
publicTalks.description: Public-friendly talks by quantum scientists at local universities, covering the motivations, history, myths, and real-world applications of quantum mechanics - no technical background required.

labTours.title: Quantum Lab Tours
labTours.description: Exclusive behind-the-scenes tours of cutting-edge university labs, offering a firsthand look at quantum research in action and conversations with working scientists.

quantumGames.title: Quantum Games
quantumGames.description: An evening of playing board games and video games that teach, explore, or are inspired by quantum mechanics.

kids.title: Quantum for Kids
kids.description: Hands-on demos and interactive activities designed to make the strange world of quantum mechanics fun and accessible for young learners.

companies.title: Quantum Tech Company Events
companies.description: Panels and showcases featuring local quantum technology companies, offering behind-the-scenes insights into the future of quantum innovation.

bar.title: Quantum at the Bar (ħ)
bar.description: A citywide outreach where graduate students, postdocs, and professors deploy to local LA bars to spark casual, lively conversations about quantum science - drinks encouraged, physics demystified.

teachers.title: Quantum for Teachers
teachers.description: Workshops and resources for educators to integrate quantum concepts into their classrooms, empowering the next generation of science learners.

stars.title: Quantum in the Stars
stars.description: An unforgettable night at Griffith Observatory learning about the quantum physics relevant to the existence of the universe.

seniors.title: Quantum for Seniors
seniors.description: Bringing quantum science to retirement communities with engaging, accessible presentations and discussions tailored for lifelong learners.
